messages:
Aisha (partnerships): Quick update 1 — Celestia Bio is live as an ISV on Azure Marketplace and their Redwood Private pilot starts next week. Big healthcare bioscience reference potential.
Marco (AE): Deal summary: 12-month pilot, committed reserved capacity, marketplace procurement approved. They requested an initial performance report and PID for procurement.
Pri (solutions): Two main workflows: 1) bulk embedding + batch rerank for literature search, 2) low-latency generative summaries for lab technicians. Need separate routing configs and cache policies.
Ravi (security): Security checklist: DPA signed, data residency set to EU-West, will require customer-managed KMS and mandatory audit logging. Also requested proof of SOC2 in onboarding.
Lena (prod): Proposed infra: small dedicated pool (1x H100), per-tenant KV prefixing for embedding cache, and per-route batching disabled for summaries to keep latency. Est p50 ~95ms for summary endpoint at baseline traffic.
infra-bot: Provision complete: cluster eu-west-2/private-celestia, kms-key=c-stia-2024, audit-log-bucket=gs://redwood-eu/logs/celestia. Provision link: https://infra.internal/provision/1745001234
Marco (AE): Celestia wants a single-pane billing view for marketplace spend + reserved capacity. Any notes on how billing will appear?
Aisha (partnerships): Finance should surface consolidated invoice; I'll loop in billing to map marketplace fees vs reserved usage.
Hannah (marketing): If pilot goes well, marketing wants a 2-paragraph case study and a short customer quote. I'll request logo and exec contact.
Pri (solutions): Action items: create two routing policies (embeddings -> pinned-embed-v1, summaries -> pinned-gen-v3), enable prefix caching for embeddings, and add a degrade-to-quantized fallback for peak events.
Ravi (security): Also require KMS rotation plan and ephemeral sandbox keys for their devs. I'll share required IAM roles.
Lena (prod): Monitoring: added SLO dashboards and alert for latency >200ms or cache miss rate >30%. Will enable autoscale with conservative headroom.
Aisha (partnerships): Great work team. I'll update when we have logo approval and the marketplace listing goes public. Please drop any meeting notes or artifacts here. :sparkles:
